definitions.gloss: pen name; pseudonym; nom de plume
definitions.explanation: A fictitious name used by a writer instead of their real name.

examples.japanese: {筆名|ひつめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To work under a pen name.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筆名|ひつめい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本名|ほんみょう}→本名：13034_honmyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知|し}られていない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That author's pen name is famous, but their real name is unknown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏目|なつめ}{漱石|そうせき}→夏目漱石：30575_natsumesouseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筆名|ひつめい}で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{本名|ほんみょう}→本名：13034_honmyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{夏目|なつめ}{金之助|きんのすけ}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: Natsume Soseki is a pen name; his real name was Natsume Kinnosuke.

notes:
A compound of {筆|ひつ} (writing brush; pen) and {名|めい} (name). Used specifically for writers and authors. In Japanese literary tradition, pen names have been used extensively, with many of Japan's most famous authors being known primarily by their {筆名|ひつめい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆名|ひつめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write under a pen name
- {筆名|ひつめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a pen name
- {筆名|ひつめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be active under a pen name
- {筆名|ひつめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{本名|ほんみょう}→本名：13034_honmyou⟧: pen name and real name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ペンネーム→ペンネーム：25452_penneemu⟧: pen name — the loanword from English, more casual and widely used in modern Japanese
- ⟦{雅号|がごう}→雅号：20754_gagou⟧: art name — a name used by artists, poets, and calligraphers, more traditional
- ⟦{芸名|げいめい}→芸名：25284_geimei⟧: stage name — used by entertainers and performers
- ⟦{匿名|とくめい}→匿名：11797_tokumei⟧: anonymity — hiding one's identity entirely rather than using a substitute name
